title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 — Artificial Intelligence Act
_what_this_is: A mini graph of the articles a behaviour policy's consequences may touch: article number, title, link. Titles and identifiers only, never the body text of a standard (site rule 7). A link from a consequence or a behaviour to a node here says the node is touched or named, never that anything complies with it (rule 6). The regulation itself may be quoted on this site; the default is still the title.
